column6: Best smartwatch display and health features
column7: The always-on retina display is razor sharp even in blazing direct sunlight. Heart rate tracking is spot on compared to my chest strap monitor. Crash detection and ECG give immense peace of mind.

column6: Fitness tracking and watchOS 10 are flawless
column7: Sleep stage breakdown is surprisingly informative. Apple Pay on wrist makes contactless payments instantaneous. Haptic engine notifications are gentle yet unmissable.
Fast charging is a huge upgrade: reaches 80% in 45 minutes while I take a shower. Aluminum unibody is durable and lightweight on the wrist.
Having to charge a watch every single day is ridiculous. If you track an outdoor GPS workout and sleep, you barely make it 18 hours before getting low power alerts.

column6: Battery lasts a day and a half at best
column7: Low Power Mode helps stretch it to 30 hours, but disables always-on display and background heart rate sampling which defeats the purpose.

column6: Skin burn and blistering under sensor
column7: Optical sensor back glass overheated during an outdoor run, causing a red circular skin burn and blister on my wrist. Had to see a doctor for topical burn cream. Dangerous overheating sensor.

column6: Battery swelling popped screen off body
column7: Woke up to find the OLED display completely popped out of the aluminum chassis due to severe lithium battery swelling. Apple Store confirmed battery expansion.
Magnetic fast charger puck and back of watch became scalding hot. Left a brown burn mark on the wood nightstand.

column6: Tough sapphire crystal and great health tools
column7: Sapphire crystal screen glass is virtually scratch-proof. Body composition BIA sensor provides helpful muscle and body fat metrics. Google Wear OS brings Google Maps and Play Store apps.
Advanced sleep coaching gives personalized tips. Speaker and microphone work well for quick wrist phone calls. Snappy animations with Exynos chip.
Lightweight armor aluminum casing. GPS tracks running routes accurately without phone tethering.

column6: ECG features locked unless you own a Samsung phone
column7: If you pair this with a Pixel, OnePlus or Xiaomi phone, Samsung locks the ECG and Blood Pressure monitor behind their proprietary Samsung Health Monitor app. Very anti-consumer.
Better than Apple Watch at around 36 to 40 hours, but still needs charging every second night.

column6: Severe overheating on charging puck with burning smell
column7: Watch displayed overheating warning triangle and shut down while charging. Back glass was blisteringly hot and smelled like burned adhesive. Major battery risk.

column6: Severe wrist rash and chemical burn
column7: Suffered redness, severe itching, and blistering rash directly under the nickel sensors. Dermatologist warned against wearing.
